Abathur.name: Abathur
Abathur.title: Evolution Master
Abathur.SearchText: Abathur Zerg Swarm HotS Heart of the Swarm StarCraft II 2 SC2 Star2 Starcraft2 SC slug Double Soak
Abathur.Description: A unique Hero that can manipulate the battle from anywhere on the map.
Abathur.InfoText: Abathur, the Evolution Master of Kerrigan's Swarm, works ceaselessly to improve the zerg from the genetic level up. His hate for chaos and imperfection almost rivals his hatred of pronouns.

AbathurSymbiote.name: Symbiote
AbathurSymbiote.ShortTooltip: Assist an ally and gain new abilities
AbathurSymbiote.FullTooltip: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

AbathurToxicNest.name: Toxic Nest
AbathurToxicNest.FullTooltip: Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals <c val="bfd4fd">153~~0.04~~</c> damage and reveals the enemy for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds. Lasts <c val="bfd4fd">90</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Stores up to <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> charges.

AbathurEvolveMonstrosity.name: Evolve Monstrosity
AbathurEvolveMonstrosity.ShortTooltip: Minion or Locust becomes a powerful Monstrosity
AbathurEvolveMonstrosity.FullTooltip: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains <c val="bfd4fd">2%</c> Health and <c val="bfd4fd">2%</c> Basic Attack damage, stacking up to <c val="bfd4fd">40</c> times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every <c val="bfd4fd">80</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

AbathurUltimateEvolution.name: Ultimate Evolution
AbathurUltimateEvolution.ShortTooltip: Clone target allied Hero and control it
AbathurUltimateEvolution.FullTooltip: Clone target allied Hero and control it for <c val="bfd4fd">20</c> seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> Spell Power, <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> bonus Attack Damage, and <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

AbathurSpawnLocusts.name: Locust Strain
AbathurSpawnLocusts.ShortTooltip: Spawn locusts that attack down the nearest lane
AbathurSpawnLocusts.FullTooltip: Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds. Locusts heal for <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> of the damage they deal, and regain <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> of their Maximum health when a nearby minion dies.<n/><n/>Locusts lose health over <c val="bfd4fd">17</c> seconds, have <c val="bfd4fd">225~~0.04~~</c> health and deal <c val="bfd4fd">36~~0.04~~</c> damage with each Basic Attack, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> bonus damage to enemy non-Heroes.

AbathurDeepTunnel.name: Deep Tunnel
AbathurDeepTunnel.FullTooltip: Quickly tunnel to a visible location.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring <c val="bfd4fd">1125</c> Health.

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

LootYellVoiceLine.name: Quick Voice Line Expression

AbathurEvolveMonstrosityActiveSymbiote.name: Evolve Monstrosity Active

AbathurReinforcedCarapace.name: Reinforced Carapace
AbathurReinforcedCarapace.FullTooltip: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c>.

AbathurCombatStyleLocustBrood.name: Locust Brood
AbathurCombatStyleLocustBrood.FullTooltip: Activate to spawn <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> Locusts at a nearby location.

AbathurSymbioteAdrenalOverload.name: Adrenal Overload
AbathurSymbioteAdrenalOverload.FullTooltip: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> increased Attack Speed.

AbathurMasteryNeedlespine.name: Needlespine

AbathurMasteryProlificDispersal.name: Prolific Dispersal

AbathurSlapathur.name: Slapathur

AbathurSlapathur.FullTooltip: Abathur’s Basic Attacks deal <c val="bfd4fd">500%</c> additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds.<n/><n/>The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds.

AbathurMasteryVileNestsToxicNest.name: Vile Nest
AbathurMasteryVileNestsToxicNest.FullTooltip: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2.5</c> seconds.

AbathurVolatileMutation.name: Volatile Mutation
AbathurVolatileMutation.FullTooltip: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal <c val="bfd4fd">137~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies every <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> of the damage dealt.

AbathurCombatStyleSurvivalInstincts.name: Survival Instincts

AbathurSymbioteStab.name: Stab

AbathurMonstrosityDeepTunnel.name: Deep Tunnel

Alarak.name: Alarak

AlarakMightOfTheHighlord.FullTooltip: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

AlarakLastLaugh.name: Last Laugh
AlarakLastLaugh.ShortTooltip: Cleanse and teleport, but reduce Health
AlarakLastLaugh.FullTooltip: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> times with Basic Abilities within <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to <c val="bfd4fd">1</c>.

AlarakHastyBargain.name: Hasty Bargain
AlarakHastyBargain.ShortTooltip: Activate to reduce Sadism bonus and reset Basic Ability cooldowns
AlarakHastyBargain.FullTooltip: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by <c val="bfd4fd">4%</c> and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

Alexstrasza.name: Alexstrasza
Alexstrasza.title: The Life-Binder
Alexstrasza.SearchText: Alexstraza Alekstrasza Alekstraza Warcraft 2 WC2 WoW Cataclysm Wrath of the Lich King WotLK dragon elf Queen of Dragons Fire Slow Displace Sustain Healer
Alexstrasza.Description: A Healer who shares her Health with allies and can transform into a Dragon to empower her Abilities.
Alexstrasza.InfoText: Alexstrasza, the queen of dragons, was empowered by the titans to be the guardian of all life on Azeroth. She has aided mortals time and again, even at great personal cost. Now, she soars across the Nexus, protecting life wherever she finds it.

AlexstraszaGiftOfLife.name: Gift of Life
AlexstraszaGiftOfLife.ShortTooltip: Give a portion of Health to an allied Hero
AlexstraszaGiftOfLife.FullTooltip: Sacrifice <c val="bfd4fd">15%</c> of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for <c val="bfd4fd">150%</c> of that amount.<n/><n/><c val="00ff90">Passive:</c> Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by <c val="bfd4fd">150%</c>.<n/><n/><c val="D65CFF">Dragonqueen: Breath of Life</c><n/>Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

AlexstraszaAbundance.name: Abundance
AlexstraszaAbundance.ShortTooltip: Heal allied Heroes in an area
AlexstraszaAbundance.FullTooltip: Plant a seed of healing that blooms after <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> of their maximum Health.<n/><n/><c val="D65CFF">Dragonqueen: Preservation</c><n/>Heal area and amount greatly increased.

AlexstraszaFlameBuffet.name: Flame Buffet
AlexstraszaFlameBuffet.ShortTooltip: Launch a fireball that ignites enemies and can Slow them
AlexstraszaFlameBuffet.FullTooltip: Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for <c val="bfd4fd">75~~0.04~~</c> damage over <c val="bfd4fd">5.5</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals <c val="bfd4fd">125~~0.04~~</c> bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> decaying over <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.<n/><n/><c val="D65CFF">Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet</c><n/>Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

AlexstraszaLifebinder.name: Life-Binder
AlexstraszaLifebinder.ShortTooltip: Link Alexstrasza's Health with an ally
AlexstraszaLifebinder.FullTooltip: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for <c val="bfd4fd">480~~0.04~~</c> Health over <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.<n/><n/><c val="D65CFF">Dragonqueen:</c> Cast range increased by <c val="bfd4fd">45%</c>.

AlexstraszaCleansingFlame.name: Cleansing Flame
AlexstraszaCleansingFlame.ShortTooltip: Rain healing and damaging fire from the sky
AlexstraszaCleansingFlame.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.25</c> seconds, take to the sky and drop <c val="bfd4fd">5</c> fireballs over <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal <c val="bfd4fd">135~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for <c val="bfd4fd">300~~0.04~~</c> Health.<n/><n/><c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

AlexstraszaDragonqueen.name: Dragonqueen
AlexstraszaDragonqueen.ShortTooltip: Transform into a dragon aspect with empowered Abilities
AlexstraszaDragonqueen.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.25</c> seconds, transform into a dragon and gain <c val="bfd4fd">500~~0.04~~</c> Health.<n/><n/>While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal <c val="bfd4fd">143~~0.04~~</c> damage and heal allied Heroes for <c val="bfd4fd">43~~0.04~~</c> in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c>.<n/><n/>Lasts <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds.

Mount.name: Summon Mount
Mount.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, gain <s val="bfd4fd" name="StandardTooltipDetails">30%</s> Movement Speed.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring <c val="bfd4fd">1125</c> Health and <c val="bfd4fd">150</c> Mana.

AlexstraszaLiveAndLetLiveGiftOfLife.name: Live and Let Live
AlexstraszaLiveAndLetLiveGiftOfLife.ShortTooltip: High Health reduces Gift of Life cooldown
AlexstraszaLiveAndLetLiveGiftOfLife.FullTooltip: While above <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges <c val="bfd4fd">125%</c> faster.<n/><n/><c val="D65CFF">Dragonqueen:</c> While above <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> faster.

AlexstraszaFlamesOfFuryFlameBuffet.name: Flames of Fury
AlexstraszaFlamesOfFuryFlameBuffet.ShortTooltip: <c val="e4b800">Quest:</c> Lower Dragonqueen cooldown, last forever
AlexstraszaFlamesOfFuryFlameBuffet.FullTooltip: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.Mythic Quest: After hitting 40 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.

AlexstraszaExuberance.name: Exuberance

Amazon.SearchText: Casia Amazon Javazon D2 Diablo 2 II Diablo2 Human Stun Blind Burst Marksman
Amazon.Description: An Assassin who specializes against Physical Attackers.
Amazon.InfoText: After shattering the Worldstone, the young Amazon Cassia had changed. She had seen hatred, terror, and destruction firsthand. If the Askari were to survive the coming darkness, they needed an army. She would begin their training immediately.

AmazonLightningFury.FullTooltip: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals <c val="bfd4fd">158~~0.04~~</c> damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal <c val="bfd4fd">158~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in their path.

Deals <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.

The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second and become marked for <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds. Upon reaching <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> marks, remove them and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

AmazonStaticElectricity.name: Static Electricity
AmazonStaticElectricity.FullTooltip: Gain <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> additional charges of Lightning Fury. Fend's impact launches a lightning bolt towards each nearby enemy Hero.

AmazonMartialLaw.name: Martial Law
AmazonMartialLaw.FullTooltip: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to <c val="bfd4fd">1%</c> of their maximum Health. Increase this to <c val="bfd4fd">3%</c> if they are Stunned, Rooted, Slowed, or Blinded.

AmazonInfiniteLightning.name: Infinite Lightning
AmazonInfiniteLightning.FullTooltip: Ball Lightning can now bounce indefinitely. Every bounce reduces its cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.

AmazonImprisoningLight.name: Imprisoning Light
AmazonImprisoningLight.FullTooltip: Upon impaling an enemy Hero, they are Blinded for <c val="bfd4fd">5</c> seconds and Cassia's Valkyrie creates a wave of light that deals <c val="bfd4fd">200~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies. This wave Silences and Roots them for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

AmazonTitansRevenge.name: Titan's Revenge
AmazonTitansRevenge.FullTooltip: Cassia's Basic Attacks now ignore Armor and while Avoidance is fully charged, they deal an additional <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> bonus damage.

Amazon-AvoidanceRockstopper.name: Rockstopper

Ana.name: Ana
Ana.title: Veteran Sniper
Ana.SearchText: Anna Human EyeOfHorus OW Amari Sleep Healer
Ana.Description: A burst Healer who uses precise skillshots to heal allies and can deny enemy healing.
Ana.InfoText: As a founding member of Overwatch and one of the world's best snipers, Ana Amari uses her skills to protect the innocent. Though she went MIA after losing her eye, Ana's sense of duty and responsibility has brought her back to the fight.

AnaHealingDart.name: Healing Dart
AnaHealingDart.ShortTooltip: Shoot a dart that heals an Ally
AnaHealingDart.FullTooltip: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for <c val="bfd4fd">195~~0.04~~</c> Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

AnaBioticGrenade.name: Biotic Grenade
AnaBioticGrenade.ShortTooltip: Toss a grenade that heals allies, prevents enemy healing
AnaBioticGrenade.FullTooltip: Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for <c val="bfd4fd">152~~0.04~~</c> Health and receive <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> increased healing from Ana for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds. Enemies hit take <c val="bfd4fd">60~~0.04~~</c> damage and receive <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> less healing for <c val="bfd4fd">1.75</c> seconds.<n/><n/>If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.

AnaSleepDart.ShortTooltip: Fire a dart that puts enemies to Sleep
AnaSleepDart.FullTooltip: Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Cannot be used on Vehicles.</c>

AnaNanoBoost.name: Nano Boost

AnaEyeOfHorusActivate.name: Eye of Horus

Allies are healed for <c val="bfd4fd">225~~0.04~~</c> and enemies are damaged for <c val="bfd4fd">135~~0.04~~</c>. Deals <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> less damage to Structures.<n/><n/>Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

AnaAimDownSightsActivate.name: Shrike

Every <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds, Ana is healed for <c val="bfd4fd">60%</c> of the damage dealt by Shrike.<n/><n/><s val="cbe8ff-ffffff" name="StandardTooltipHeader">Aim Down Sights</s><n/><n/>Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c>, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

Mount.name: Summon Mount

Anduin.name: Anduin
Anduin.title: King of Stormwind
Anduin.SearchText: Human Wrynn Priest Stormwind Alliance WoW World of Warcraft Burning Crusade BC Wrath Lich King WotLK Cataclysm Mists of Pandaria MoP Warlords Draenor WoD Legion Hearthstone HS BFA Battle for Azeroth Root Stun Sustain Healer
Anduin.Description: A ranged Healer with the ability to pluck an ally from danger.
Anduin.InfoText: As a young man, Anduin sought peace as a priest of the Holy Light and an envoy of the Alliance. After his father, Varian, fell to the Burning Legion, Anduin took up the crown as High King of the Alliance. He soon learned that peace must be fought for, even in the Nexus.

AnduinLightBomb.name: Lightbomb

Chromie.name: Chromie

Deathwing.SearchText: Warcraft WC2 WoW Cataclysm dragon Neltharion the Earth-Warder Warcraft 2 Stun Slow CC Global Offlaner Fire
Deathwing.Description: A Massive Unstoppable Dragon that can withstand punishment while dishing it out, but is unaffected by allied Abilities.
Deathwing.InfoText: One of the five Dragon Aspects and the leader of the Black Dragonflight, Neltharion the Earth-Warder was once a protector of Azeroth. During the War of the Ancients, he was driven mad by the Old Gods and turned against his former allies. Now known as Deathwing the Destroyer, he has found his way to the Nexus where his limitless rage drives his ultimate goal of widespread destruction and the eventual end of all living things.

DeathwingMoltenFlame.name: Molten Flame
DeathwingMoltenFlame.ShortTooltip: Melt enemies with a stream of molten flame
DeathwingMoltenFlame.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds, Deathwing breathes a stream of flame, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">20~~0.04~~</c> damage every <c val="bfd4fd">0.125</c> seconds. Drains <c val="bfd4fd">30</c> Energy per second.

DeathwingIncinerate.name: Incinerate
DeathwingIncinerate.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds, Deathwing flaps his wings, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">100~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies.<n/><n/><c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker: Lava Burst</c><n/>Create a lava pool that damages and Slows

DeathwingOnslaught.name: Onslaught
DeathwingOnslaught.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds, Deathwing lunges in a direction dealing <c val="bfd4fd">60~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies and Slowing them by <c val="bfd4fd">35%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. Deathwing bites enemies at the end of the lunge, dealing an additional <c val="bfd4fd">120~~0.04~~</c> damage.<n/><n/><c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker: Earth Shatter</c><n/>Damage and Stun enemies in two lines

DeathwingCataclysm.name: Cataclysm
DeathwingCataclysm.ShortTooltip: Deathwing flies over an area, causing devastation in his wake.
DeathwingCataclysm.FullTooltip: After 2 seconds, Deathwing flies in the targeted direction, dealing 90~~0.04~~ damage on impact and leaving scorched ground that deals 36~~0.04~~ damage a second. Lasts 6 seconds.Quest: Hit Heroes with Molten Flame to grant 1 stack.Quest: Score Takedowns to grant 50 stacks.Mythic Reward: After reaching 2000 stacks, Deathwing brings on the Hour of Twilight. Cataclysm's periodic damage to Structures is increased by 2500%.

DeathwingAspectOfDeath.name: Aspect of Death
DeathwingAspectOfDeath.ShortTooltip: Deathwing is especially powerful, but ignores friendly effects
DeathwingAspectOfDeath.FullTooltip: Deathwing is fitted with <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> Armor Plates which grant <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> Armor each. Every <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing.<n/><n/>Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.

DeathwingDragonflight.name: Dragonflight
DeathwingDragonflight.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, fly into the sky, becoming Immune to all effects and gaining <c val="bfd4fd">2.5%</c> Health per second. Once cast, this ability cannot be interrupted. Cannot be cast for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds after taking damage, Basic Attacking or casting an Ability.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms.

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

LootYellVoiceLine.name: Quick Voice Line Expression
LootYellVoiceLine.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by playing your selected Voice Line.

DeathwingDestroyerForm.name: Destroyer
DeathwingDestroyerForm.ShortTooltip: Land on the ground in Destroyer form
DeathwingDestroyerForm.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.75</c> seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">50~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in the area and landing in <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds after landing.

DeathwingWorldbreakerForm.name: World Breaker
DeathwingWorldbreakerForm.ShortTooltip: Land on the ground in World Breaker form
DeathwingWorldbreakerForm.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.75</c> seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">50~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in the area and landing in <c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker</c> form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds after landing.

DeathwingMoltenFlameCancel.name: Cancel
DeathwingMoltenFlameCancel.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds, Deathwing breathes a stream of flame, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">20~~0.04~~</c> damage every <c val="bfd4fd">0.125</c> seconds. Drains <c val="bfd4fd">30</c> Energy per second.

DeathwingLavaBurst.name: Lava Burst
DeathwingLavaBurst.ShortTooltip: Create a lava pool that damages and Slows
DeathwingLavaBurst.FullTooltip: After a <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second delay, deal <c val="bfd4fd">35~~0.04~~</c> damage to all enemies in an area and create a pool of magma that deals <c val="bfd4fd">28~~0.04~~</c> damage per second and Slows enemies by <c val="bfd4fd">45%</c>. Lasts <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds.<n/><n/><c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer: Incinerate</c><n/>Damage enemies near Deathwing

DeathwingEarthShatter.name: Earth Shatter
DeathwingEarthShatter.ShortTooltip: Damage and Stun enemies in two lines
DeathwingEarthShatter.FullTooltip: Create a fissure of earth that deals <c val="bfd4fd">90~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies hit and Stuns them for <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds.<n/><n/><c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer: Onslaught</c><n/>Lunge in a direction

DeathwingSkyfall.name: Skyfall
DeathwingSkyfall.ShortTooltip: Deathwing can drop meteors while in Dragonflight
DeathwingSkyfall.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">0.8</c> seconds, a meteor falls from the sky, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">58~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in the area.<n/><n/>If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for <c val="bfd4fd">3%</c> of his maximum Health.

DeathwingDragonSoul.name: Dragon Soul
DeathwingDragonSoul.ShortTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Incinerate</c>, <c val="d8ab80-87564b">Lava Burst</c> explosion heal Deathwing
DeathwingDragonSoul.FullTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer:</c> <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Incinerate</c> heals Deathwing for <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.<n/><n/><c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker: Lava Burst's</c> explosion damage heals Deathwing for <c val="bfd4fd">200%</c> of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.

DeathwingMoltenBlood.name: Molten Blood
DeathwingMoltenBlood.FullTooltip: While Deathwing has <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> or more Armor Plates, he heals for <c val="bfd4fd">0.6%</c> of his maximum Health per second.

DeathwingDraconicMight.name: Draconic Might
DeathwingDraconicMight.ShortTooltip: Protected from Armor Plate loss, Basic Attacks heal
DeathwingDraconicMight.FullTooltip: Deathwing's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal him for <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> of the damage dealt. Upon losing an Armor Plate, Deathwing becomes Protected for <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds.

DeathwingInfernus.name: Infernus
DeathwingInfernus.ShortTooltip: Increase Molten Flame damage at high Energy
DeathwingInfernus.FullTooltip: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c>. Increase this damage bonus to <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> when Molten Flame is cast at <c val="bfd4fd">75</c> Energy or higher.

DeathwingHeatWave.name: Heat Wave
DeathwingHeatWave.ShortTooltip: Increase <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Incinerate</c> and <c val="d8ab80-87564b">Lava Burst</c> damage
DeathwingHeatWave.FullTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer:</c> After hitting an enemy Hero with <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Incinerate</c>, Deathwing deals <c val="bfd4fd">18~~0.04~~</c> damage per second to all nearby enemies for the next <c val="bfd4fd">9</c> seconds. Stacks up to <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> times.<n/><n/><c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker:</c> Increase the explosion damage of <c val="d8ab80-87564b">Lava Burst</c> by <c val="bfd4fd">150%</c>.

DeathwingDragonsIre.name: Dragon's Ire
DeathwingDragonsIre.ShortTooltip: Deathwing gains damage while missing Armor Plates
DeathwingDragonsIre.FullTooltip: While Deathwing has <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> or fewer Armor Plates, his damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c>.

DeathwingFirestorm.name: Firestorm
DeathwingFirestorm.ShortTooltip: Meteors upon landing, reduced landing delay.
DeathwingFirestorm.FullTooltip: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds. When Deathwing lands, he drops <c val="bfd4fd">7</c> meteors near the landing area, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">77~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies hit. <n/><n/>Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

DeathwingDeathDrop.name: Death Drop
DeathwingDeathDrop.ShortTooltip: Landing on Heroes reduces Spell Armor
DeathwingDeathDrop.FullTooltip: Hitting an enemy Hero with <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> or <c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker's</c> landing damage reduces their Spell Armor by <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds and Deathwing's Basic Ability cooldowns by <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.

DeathwingSkyfall.name: Skyfall
DeathwingSkyfall.ShortTooltip: Deathwing can drop meteors to heal himself
DeathwingSkyfall.FullTooltip: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing <c val="bfd4fd">58~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in the area. Has <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> charges.<n/><n/>If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for <c val="bfd4fd">3%</c> of his maximum Health.

DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.name: Burn Beneath My Shadow
DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.ShortTooltip: Destroying Forts or Keeps refreshes Cataclysm
DeathwingBurnBeneathMyShadow.FullTooltip: When an enemy Fort or Keep is destroyed the cooldown of Cataclysm is reset. Cataclysm's periodic damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">80%</c>.

DeathwingBellowingRoar.name: Bellowing Roar
DeathwingBellowingRoar.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">25~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds.

DeathwingWickedInferno.name: Wicked Inferno
DeathwingWickedInferno.FullTooltip: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by <c val="bfd4fd">10</c>. After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> Energy over <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

DeathwingRuination.name: Ruination
DeathwingRuination.ShortTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Onslaught</c> bite Slows, <c val="d8ab80-87564b">Earth Shatter</c> cost reduced
DeathwingRuination.FullTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer:</c> The bite from <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Onslaught</c> now Slows by <c val="bfd4fd">60%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds.<n/><n/><c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker:</c> Reduce <c val="d8ab80-87564b">Earth Shatter's</c> cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds and its Energy cost by <c val="bfd4fd">10</c>.

DeathwingFireAndFury.name: Fire and Fury
DeathwingFireAndFury.ShortTooltip: Empower Basic Attacks against disabled enemies
DeathwingFireAndFury.FullTooltip: Basic Attacks against Rooted, Slowed, or Stunned enemy Heroes deal <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> additional damage and reduce the cooldowns of Deathwing's Basic Abilities by <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds.

DeathwingConflagration.name: Conflagration
DeathwingConflagration.ShortTooltip: Molten Flame causes Heroes to explode
DeathwingConflagration.FullTooltip: Dealing <c val="bfd4fd">320~~0.04~~</c> damage with Molten Flame to enemy Heroes within <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds causes them to burn for an additional <c val="bfd4fd">100~~0.04~~</c> damage over <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds. While burning, they explode every <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">80~~0.04~~</c> damage to all nearby enemies.

DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.name: Gaze Onto Destruction
DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.ShortTooltip: Landing on Heroes Slows and reduces damage
DeathwingGazeOntoDestruction.FullTooltip: Hitting Heroes with <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> or <c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker's</c> landing causes their damage to be reduced by <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> and Slows them by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">3.5</c> Seconds.

DeathwingElementiumPlating.name: Elementium Plating
DeathwingElementiumPlating.ShortTooltip: Activate to gain a Shield, restore Health
DeathwingElementiumPlating.FullTooltip: Activate to gain a Shield equal to <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> of Deathwing's missing Health for <c val="bfd4fd">8</c> seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates <c val="bfd4fd">2%</c> of his maximum Health per second. <n/><n/>When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.<n/><n/>The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

DeathwingStoodInTheFire.name: Stood in the Fire
DeathwingStoodInTheFire.FullTooltip: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c>.

DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.name: Arrival of a God
DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.ShortTooltip: Landing damage increased, gain all level 7 talents
DeathwingArrivalOfAGod.FullTooltip: <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> or <c val="d8ab80-87564b">World Breaker's</c> landing damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">400%</c>.<n/><n/>Deathwing also gains the benefits of all of his level <c val="bfd4fd">7</c> talents.

DeathwingDestroyersRampage.name: Destroyer's Rampage
DeathwingDestroyersRampage.ShortTooltip: Landing in <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> form empowers Deathwing
DeathwingDestroyersRampage.FullTooltip: For the next <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds after landing in <c val="ef6e28-ad231e">Destroyer</c> form, Deathwing's damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> and his Basic Ability cooldowns recharge <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> faster.<n/><n/>Damaging Heroes refreshes this effect.

Deckard.name: Deckard
Deckard.title: The Last Horadrim
Deckard.SearchText: Cain D1 D2 D3 Diablo 1 2 3 I II III Diablo1 Diablo2 Diablo3 Root Displace Sleep Healer Potion
Deckard.Description: A burst Healer who excels at preparing the battlefield before a fight and can cripple enemies with crowd control.
Deckard.InfoText: As an avid scholar, Deckard Cain has dedicated his life to the pursuit of knowledge. He has been an advisor, storyteller, and friend to Sanctuary's greatest heroes, guiding them through peril time and again. When Deckard speaks, it's wise to stay awhile and listen.

DeckardHealingPotion.name: Healing Potion
DeckardHealingPotion.FullTooltip: Throw a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero that comes in contact with it for <c val="bfd4fd">285~~0.04~~</c>.<n/><n/>Limit <c val="bfd4fd">5</c> active Potions.

DeckardHoradricCube.name: Horadric Cube
DeckardHoradricCube.ShortTooltip: Damage and Slow enemies in an area
DeckardHoradricCube.FullTooltip: Release the Horadric Cube. After <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds it explodes, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">80~~0.04~~</c> damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by <c val="bfd4fd">35%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.

DeckardScrollOfSealing.name: Scroll Of Sealing
DeckardScrollOfSealing.ShortTooltip: Damage and Root enemies in an area
DeckardScrollOfSealing.FullTooltip: Unfurl an enchanted scroll over <c val="bfd4fd">2.25</c> seconds, forming a triangle that deals <c val="bfd4fd">150~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies inside and Roots them for <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds.

DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.ShortTooltip: Put enemies to Sleep with a fascinating story
DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, Channel for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds after.<n/><n/>Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

DeckardLorenado.name: Lorenado
DeckardLorenado.ShortTooltip: Conjure a lorenado that knocks enemies away
DeckardLorenado.FullTooltip: <c val="bfd4fd">Vector Targeting</c><n/>After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals <c val="bfd4fd">20~~0.04~~</c> damage to Heroes hit.

DeckardFortitudeOfTheFaithful.name: Fortitude of the Faithful
DeckardFortitudeOfTheFaithful.ShortTooltip: Nearby allies grant Armor, cooldown reduction
DeckardFortitudeOfTheFaithful.FullTooltip: When at least <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> faster.

Mount.name: Summon Mount
Mount.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, gain <s val="bfd4fd" name="StandardTooltipDetails">30%</s> Movement Speed.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring <c val="bfd4fd">1125</c> Health and <c val="bfd4fd">150</c> Mana.

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

LootYellVoiceLine.name: Quick Voice Line Expression
LootYellVoiceLine.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by playing your selected Voice Line.

DeckardAncientBlessings.name: Fortitude of the Faithful
DeckardAncientBlessings.FullTooltip: When at least <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> faster.<n/><n/>Activate to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for <c val="bfd4fd">8</c> seconds, causing them to deal an additional <c val="bfd4fd">62~~0.04~~</c> damage in an area and heal for <c val="bfd4fd">90~~0.04~~</c> for each Hero hit.

DeckardScrollOfIdentify.name: Scroll of Identify
DeckardScrollOfIdentify.ShortTooltip: <c val="e4b800">Quest:</c> Increase Scroll of Sealing damage, reduces Armor
DeckardScrollOfIdentify.FullTooltip: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2.Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

DeckardFieldStudy.name: Field Study
DeckardFieldStudy.ShortTooltip: Scroll of Sealing can grant Spell Power
DeckardFieldStudy.FullTooltip: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> Spell Power for <c val="bfd4fd">16</c> seconds, up to <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c>.

DeckardGemSapphire.name: Sapphire
DeckardGemSapphire.FullTooltip: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by <c val="bfd4fd">100% </c>and its slow by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c>.<n/><n/>Only <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardPotionOfShielding.name: Potion of Shielding
DeckardPotionOfShielding.FullTooltip: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a <c val="bfd4fd">140~~0.04~~</c> Shield for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds.

DeckardRejuvenationPotion.name: Rejuvenation Potion
DeckardRejuvenationPotion.ShortTooltip: Healing Potions restore Mana, heal more
DeckardRejuvenationPotion.FullTooltip: Healing Potions restore <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> Mana and heal for an additional <c val="bfd4fd">114~~0.04~~</c> over <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

DeckardGemRuby.name: Ruby
DeckardGemRuby.ShortTooltip: Next Horadric Cube creates Lesser Healing Potions
DeckardGemRuby.FullTooltip: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by <c val="bfd4fd">100% </c> and it spawns <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for <c val="bfd4fd">250~~0.04~~</c> when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Only <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardCubeMastery.name: Cube Mastery
DeckardCubeMastery.ShortTooltip: Horadric Cube reduces Scroll of Sealing cooldown
DeckardCubeMastery.FullTooltip: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from <c val="bfd4fd">40</c> to <c val="bfd4fd">25</c>. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.

DeckardKanaisCube.name: Kanai's Cube
DeckardKanaisCube.ShortTooltip: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt
DeckardKanaisCube.FullTooltip: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.

DeckardGemEmerald.name: Emerald
DeckardGemEmerald.ShortTooltip: Next Horadric Cube reduces enemy healing received
DeckardGemEmerald.FullTooltip: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by <c val="bfd4fd">100% </c>and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Only <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> Gem may be active at a time.

DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.ShortTooltip: Put enemies to Sleep with a fascinating story
DeckardStayAWhileAndListen.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, Channel for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds after.<n/><n/>Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

DeckardLorenado.name: Lorenado
DeckardLorenado.ShortTooltip: Conjure a lorenado that knocks enemies away
DeckardLorenado.FullTooltip: <c val="bfd4fd">Vector Targeting</c><n/>After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals <c val="bfd4fd">20~~0.04~~</c> damage to Heroes hit.

DeckardSuperHealingPotion.name: Super Healing Potion
DeckardSuperHealingPotion.ShortTooltip: Healing Potions heal more after a duration
DeckardSuperHealingPotion.FullTooltip: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds, it heals for <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> more.<n/><n/><c val="00ff90">Passive: </c>Healing Potion heals for <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> more when the target is under <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> health.

DeckardPotionOfRevival.name: Potion of Revival
DeckardPotionOfRevival.ShortTooltip: Healing Potions heal in an area
DeckardPotionOfRevival.FullTooltip: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> of the healing amount.

DeckardAncientBlessings.name: Ancient Blessings
DeckardAncientBlessings.ShortTooltip: Activate Fortitude to empower ally Attacks
DeckardAncientBlessings.FullTooltip: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for <c val="bfd4fd">8</c> seconds, causing them to deal an additional <c val="bfd4fd">62~~0.04~~</c> damage in an area and heal for <c val="bfd4fd">90~~0.04~~</c> for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

HoggerAggroRange.name: Aggro Range

HoggerSeeingRed.name: Seeing Red

HoggerHoardapult.name: Hoardapult
HoggerHoardapult.FullTooltip: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">100~~0.04~~</c> damage and Slowing enemies by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to <c val="bfd4fd">20</c> seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

HoggerShockwave.name: Shockwave
HoggerShockwave.ShortTooltip: Damage and Stun in long line
HoggerShockwave.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take <c val="bfd4fd">230~~0.04~~</c> damage and are Stunned for <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds.

HoggerDustDevil.name: Dust Devil

HoggerFurzerker.name: Furzerker

Lucio.name: Lúcio
Lucio.title: Freedom Fighting DJ
Lucio.SearchText: Lucio Human Overwatch OW Displace Mobile Mobility Sustain Shields Healer
Lucio.Description: A sustained Healer who gives his team mobility and peels enemies off allies.
Lucio.InfoText: From the streets of Rio to the clubs on King's Row, Lúcio's beats bring the party to life, and drive the people to action. Now he's on tour in the Nexus, ready to break it down, and to continue fighting for what's right.

LucioSoundwave.name: Soundwave
LucioSoundwave.FullTooltip: Deal <c val="bfd4fd">105~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

LucioCrossfade.name: Crossfade
LucioCrossfade.ShortTooltip: Play a <c val="FFF800">Healing Boost</c> or <c val="3DFF7F">Speed Boost</c> track
LucioCrossfade.FullTooltip: Currently playing <c val="3DFF7F">Speed Boost</c>, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c>.<n/><n/>Toggle to play <c val="FFF800">Healing Boost</c> instead.

LucioAmpItUp.name: Amp It Up
LucioAmpItUp.ShortTooltip: Boost the effect of Lúcio's Crossfade track
LucioAmpItUp.FullTooltip: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, amping <c val="FFF800">Healing Boost</c> to <c val="bfd4fd">112~~0.04~~</c> Health per second and <c val="3DFF7F">Speed Boost</c> to <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> increased Movement Speed.

LucioSoundBarrier.name: Sound Barrier
LucioSoundBarrier.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a <c val="bfd4fd">1296~~0.04~~</c> point Shield that rapidly decays over <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds.

LucioHighFive.name: High Five

LucioHighFive.FullTooltip: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for <c val="bfd4fd">230~~0.04~~</c>, Lúcio is healed for <c val="bfd4fd">80~~0.04~~</c>, and both gain Unstoppable for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second.

LucioPushOff.name: Push Off
LucioPushOff.ShortTooltip: Push off a wall to Slow enemies
LucioPushOff.FullTooltip: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take <c val="bfd4fd">100~~0.04~~</c> damage and are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second.

LucioWallRide.name: Wall Ride

LucioWallRide.FullTooltip: When moving alongside terrain, Lúcio begins to Wall Ride for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. While Wall Ride is active, Lúcio can walk through units and gains <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

Medivh.name: Medivh

Medivh.Description: A Support who can negate burst damage and allow his allies to teleport.
Medivh.InfoText: Under the demon lord Sargeras's influence, Medivh opened the Dark Portal and unleashed the Horde upon Azeroth. To atone for this sin, he rallied a new generation of heroes to stand against the Burning Legion. Now, he takes his place amongst legends.

MeiOW.name: Mei

MeiOW.SearchText: Mei-Ling Zhou Human Overwatch OW Ice Frost Slow Displace CC Initiation Wall Time Stop Dive Escape

Necromancer.SearchText: Xul Xuul Zuul Zul Zool Necromancer Human D2 Diablo 2 II Diablo2 Push Siege Root Slow Summoner Double Soak Offlaner
Necromancer.Description: A Summoner who can push multiple lanes with ease.
Necromancer.InfoText: From the recesses of the eastern jungles comes a man cloaked in mystery. As a member of the secretive Priests of Rathma, or the Necromancers, Xul wields powerful death magic and fights to preserve the delicate balance between order and chaos.

NecromancerSpectralScythe.name: Spectral Scythe
NecromancerSpectralScythe.ShortTooltip: Throw a scythe that damages enemies as it returns to Xul
NecromancerSpectralScythe.FullTooltip: Summon a scythe that travels to Xul after <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">190~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies and spawning a Skeletal Warrior when hitting enemy Heroes. These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.

NecromancerCursedStrikes.name: Cursed Strikes
NecromancerCursedStrikes.ShortTooltip: Basic Attacks deal damage in an area and reduce Attack Speed
NecromancerCursedStrikes.FullTooltip: Xul's Basic Attacks deal damage in a wide area and reduce the Attack Speed of Heroes and Summons by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. Lasts <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds once triggered.

NecromancerBonePrison.name: Bone Prison
NecromancerBonePrison.FullTooltip: After a <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> second delay, deal <c val="bfd4fd">80~~0.04~~</c> damage and Root the target enemy Hero for <c val="bfd4fd">1.75</c> seconds. All nearby Skeletal Warriors will fixate on the target for their duration.

NecromancerSkeletalMages.name: Skeletal Mages
NecromancerSkeletalMages.ShortTooltip: Summon Frost Mages to damage and Slow enemies
NecromancerSkeletalMages.FullTooltip: <c val="bfd4fd">Vector Targeting</c><n/>Summon <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for <c val="bfd4fd">47~~0.04~~</c> damage a second and Slow them by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. Last up to <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds.

NecromancerPoisonNovaInstant.name: Poison Nova
NecromancerPoisonNovaInstant.ShortTooltip: Poison enemies in a large area
NecromancerPoisonNovaInstant.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">0.5</c> seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal <c val="bfd4fd">630~~0.04~~</c> damage to all enemies hit over <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds.

NecromancerRaiseSkeletonDisplayAbility.name: Raise Skeleton
NecromancerRaiseSkeletonDisplayAbility.FullTooltip: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior with <c val="bfd4fd">240~~0.04~~</c> Health that attacks for <c val="bfd4fd">21~~0.04~~</c> damage and lasts up to <c val="bfd4fd">12</c> seconds. Upon death, Skeletal Warriors deal <c val="bfd4fd">40~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies. Up to <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> Skeletal Warriors can be active at once when spawned in this way.

Mount.name: Summon Mount
Mount.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, gain <s val="bfd4fd" name="StandardTooltipDetails">30%</s> Movement Speed.

NecromancerBoneArmor.name: Bone Armor
NecromancerBoneArmor.FullTooltip: Activate to gain a Shield equal to <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> of Xul's maximum Health for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring <c val="bfd4fd">1125</c> Health and <c val="bfd4fd">150</c> Mana.

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

NecromancerTalentBoneArmorBacklash.name: Backlash
NecromancerTalentBoneArmorBacklash.FullTooltip: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to <c val="bfd4fd">12%</c> of their maximum Health.

NecromancerTalentBoneArmorShade.FullTooltip: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentReapersToll.name: Reaper's Toll
NecromancerTalentReapersToll.ShortTooltip: Lower Spectral Scythe cooldown, Mana cost
NecromancerTalentReapersToll.FullTooltip: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds and its Mana cost by <c val="bfd4fd">15</c>.

NecromancerTalentGrimScythe.name: Grim Scythe
NecromancerTalentGrimScythe.FullTooltip: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by <c val="bfd4fd">15%</c>. Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, up to <c val="bfd4fd">12</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentJailors.name: Jailors

NecromancerTalentJailors.FullTooltip: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors. These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

NecromancerTalentHarvestVitality.name: Harvest Vitality
NecromancerTalentHarvestVitality.FullTooltip: Cursed Strikes heals for <c val="bfd4fd">70%</c> of the damage dealt to Heroes.

NecromancerTalentTragOulsEssence.name: Trag'Oul's Essence
NecromancerTalentTragOulsEssence.ShortTooltip: Skeletal Warrior attacks restore Health, Mana
NecromancerTalentTragOulsEssence.FullTooltip: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore <c val="bfd4fd">0.5%</c> of Xul's maximum Health and <c val="bfd4fd">0.2%</c> of his maximum Mana.

NecromancerBoneArmorWallOfBonesTalent.name: Wall Of Bones
NecromancerBoneArmorWallOfBonesTalent.FullTooltip: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to <c val="bfd4fd">35%</c> of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains <c val="bfd4fd">20</c> Spell Armor for its duration.

NecromancerHeroicAbilitySkeletalMages.name: Skeletal Mages
NecromancerHeroicAbilitySkeletalMages.ShortTooltip: Summon Frost Mages to damage and Slow enemies

Last up to <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentEchoesOfDeath.name: Echoes of Death
NecromancerTalentEchoesOfDeath.FullTooltip: Spectral Scythe spawns <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> additional scythes next to the first after <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> damage.

NecromancerTalentRapidHarvest.FullTooltip: Gain <c val="bfd4fd">5%</c> Attack Speed for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to <c val="bfd4fd">75%</c>.

NecromancerTalentAmplifyDamage.FullTooltip: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by <c val="bfd4fd">0.25</c> seconds. Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose <c val="bfd4fd">25</c> Armor for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentDecrepify.name: Decrepify
NecromancerTalentDecrepify.FullTooltip: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2.5</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentWeaken.name: Weaken
NecromancerTalentWeaken.ShortTooltip: Cursed Strikes, Skeletal Warriors reduce damage dealt
NecromancerTalentWeaken.FullTooltip: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal <c val="bfd4fd">35%</c> less damage for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

NecromancerTalentBoneSpear.name: Bone Spear
NecromancerTalentBoneSpear.FullTooltip: Deal <c val="bfd4fd">230~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in a line.

NecromancerTalentAndarielsVisage.name: Andariel's Visage
NecromancerTalentAndarielsVisage.ShortTooltip: Increase Poison Nova duration, now heals
NecromancerTalentAndarielsVisage.FullTooltip: Poison Nova heals for <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c>.

NecromancerTalentColdHandOfDeath.name: Cold Hand of Death
NecromancerTalentColdHandOfDeath.FullTooltip: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c>. <n/><n/>Every <c val="bfd4fd">5th</c> Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior at their location.

NecromancerTalentKalansEdict.name: Kalan's Edict

NexusHunter.name: Qhira
NexusHunter.title: Realmless Bounty Hunter
NexusHunter.SearchText: Human Nexus Hunter Mercenary Sword Chainblade Stun Ganker Dive Burst
NexusHunter.Description: A brutal Melee Assassin who is adept at both beginning and ending fights.
NexusHunter.InfoText: A sworn knight and holder of a singularity shard, Qhira's only desire is to seek out others who may have escaped the destruction of her doomed home realm, Iresia. While she searches, she gets by as a bounty hunter – a job she loathes, despite her exceptional skill.

NexusHunterCarnage.name: Carnage
NexusHunterCarnage.ShortTooltip: Unleash your blade to deal damage in an area in front of you
NexusHunterCarnage.FullTooltip: Unleash your sword in the target direction, continuously dealing <c val="bfd4fd">30~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies caught in its path.

NexusHunterBloodRage.name: Blood Rage
NexusHunterBloodRage.ShortTooltip: Your Basic Attacks and Abilities cause enemies to take damage over time
NexusHunterBloodRage.FullTooltip: Qhira deals 32~~0.04~~ damage and heals for 90~~0.04~~ Health per enemy Hero affected. Damage and healing is increased by 50% per each additional stack on that Hero.Passive: Basic Attack and Ability damage cause enemies to bleed for 32~~0.04~~ damage over 4 seconds. Stacks 5 times.Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage to permanently increase its damage by 0.24%. Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

NexusHunterRevolvingSweep.name: Revolving Sweep
NexusHunterRevolvingSweep.ShortTooltip: Attach to an enemy Hero to rotate around and Stun them
NexusHunterRevolvingSweep.FullTooltip: Attach your sword on the first enemy Hero hit, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">96~~0.04~~</c> damage and Stunning them for <c val="bfd4fd">0.25</c> seconds. Once attached, Qhira becomes Immune to all effects, swinging around the target for <c val="bfd4fd">2.75</c> seconds and dealing <c val="bfd4fd">105~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies between you and the target.<n/><n/>Re-activate to send you to the target's location knocking them away, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">108~~0.04~~</c> damage and Stunning them for <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds.

NexusHunterUnrelentingStrikes.name: Unrelenting Strikes

NexusHunterFinalStrikeActivate.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, deal <c val="bfd4fd">410~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> against enemy Heroes who are below <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> Health.

NexusHunterGrapplingHook.name: Grappling Hook

NexusHunterGrapplingHook.FullTooltip: Qhira fires a grappling hook that pulls her to terrain it contacts. NexusHunterBloodRageYourPainMyGain.name: Your Pain, My Gain

Nova.name: Nova
Nova.title: Dominion Ghost
Nova.SearchText: Nova Terra Ghost Mage November Terran SC2 StarCraft 2 II Wings of Liberty WoL Heart of the Swarm HotS SC Covert Ops CO Star2 Starcraft2 Slow Cloak Stealth Burst Roam Ganker
Nova.Description: A burst damage Mage who can ambush enemies from Stealth.
Nova.InfoText: November "Nova" Terra is a ghost of the Terran Dominion and one of the most powerful psionic soldiers ever known. Nova is highly focused, determined, and extremely deadly. Even Jim Raynor wouldn't want to be caught in her crosshairs.

NovaSnipeStorm.name: Snipe
NovaSnipeStorm.ShortTooltip: Fire a shot and deal a large amount of damage to the first enemy hit
NovaSnipeStorm.FullTooltip: Deal <c val="bfd4fd">230~~0.04~~</c> damage to the first enemy hit.<n/><n/><c val="00ff90">Passive:</c> Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe permanently increases the damage of Snipe by <c val="bfd4fd">6%</c>, stacking up to <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c>. Rehgar.name: Rehgar

Rehgar.SearchText: Rehgar Regar Earthfury Orc Shaman Horde WoW World of Warcraft Legion Slow Camps Sustain Dive Escape Healer
Rehgar.Description: A well-rounded Healer that pairs well with Melee allies.
Rehgar.InfoText: Rehgar Earthfury has seen his share of combat, both as a gladiator, and a master of his own team. Now, having put that life aside, he serves as a simple shaman of the Earthen Ring, earning his redemption by healing the lands of Azeroth.

Stitches.name: Stitches
Stitches.title: Terror of Darkshire
Stitches.SearchText: Stitches Abomination Undead WoW World of Warcraft hook Slow Stun CC Initiation Displace Sustain
Stitches.Description: A Tank who wants to isolate distant enemies away from their team.
Stitches.InfoText: Take care when traversing the shadowed trails of Duskwood...<n/>Ever since Abercrombie the Embalmer unleashed his vile abomination upon Darkshire, Stitches has wandered the road aimlessly, hungering for the flesh of low level Alliance players.

StitchesSlam.name: Slam

StitchesDevour.name: Devour
StitchesDevour.ShortTooltip: Damage an enemy and restore Health

StitchesPutridBile.name: Putrid Bile

StitchesShamblingHorror.ShortTooltip: Attacks poison, activate to prevent Slows

Deals <c val="bfd4fd">150%</c> more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

Mount.name: Summon Mount

StitchesHookHelpingHand.name: Helping Hand

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone

StitchesPatchworkCreation.name: Patchwork Creation

StitchesPutrefaction.name: Putrefaction
StitchesPutrefaction.ShortTooltip: Vile Gas heals, empowered during Shambling Horror

StitchesHeroicAbilityPutridBile.name: Putrid Bile

StitchesHookMasterHooker.name: Master Hooker

Stukov.name: Stukov

Stukov.SearchText: Stewkov Starcraft Brood War BW SC2 SC Heart of the Swarm HotS Legacy of the Void LotV Zerg Infested Terran UED Alexei Silence Slow Displace Sustain Healer
Stukov.Description: A Healer that brings high amounts of disruption from long range.
Stukov.InfoText: Alexei Stukov had a hard life, and an even harder death. He has been betrayed, shot into space, resurrected and infested, almost cured, and then experimented upon as the infestation returned. Now, his infestation spreads within the Nexus...

Deals an additional <c val="bfd4fd">88~~0.04~~</c> damage upon expiring or being removed.

StukovLurkingArm.name: Lurking Arm

Stukov gains <c val="bfd4fd">50</c> Armor while shoving an enemy.

GazloweXplodiumChargeArkReaktor.FullTooltip: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.<n/><n/>These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

GazloweOverklock.name: Overklock
GazloweOverklock.ShortTooltip: Attacks grant Move Speed, deal bonus damage
GazloweOverklock.FullTooltip: Basic Attacks grant Gazlowe <c val="bfd4fd">15%</c> Movement Speed for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Dealing Basic Attack damage to Heroes causes them to take an additional <c val="bfd4fd">2.5%</c> of their maximum Health as damage.

TinkerMasteryMechaLord.name: Mecha-Lord
TinkerMasteryMechaLord.ShortTooltip: Basic Attacks grant Armor, can deal bonus damage
TinkerMasteryMechaLord.FullTooltip: Basic Attacks increase Gazlowe's Armor by <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> seconds, up to a maximum of <c val="bfd4fd">30</c>, and deal <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> bonus damage to Stunned or Slowed enemies.

TinkerMasteryMiniatureBlackHole.name: Miniature Black Hole
TinkerMasteryMiniatureBlackHole.ShortTooltip: Increase radius and damage, reduce cooldown
TinkerMasteryMiniatureBlackHole.FullTooltip: Increase Grav-O-Bomb 3000's radius by <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> and its damage by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c>. Each enemy Hero pulled reduces its cooldown by <c val="bfd4fd">12</c> seconds.

TinkerItsRainingScrap.name: It's Raining Scrap
TinkerItsRainingScrap.ShortTooltip: Rock-It! Turrets cost less Scrap, grant more Scrap
TinkerItsRainingScrap.FullTooltip: Reduce the Scrap cost of Rock-It! Turrets by <c val="bfd4fd">1</c>. Regain <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> Scrap for each Scrap pickup.

GazloweXplodiumChargeBombToss.name: Bomb Toss
GazloweXplodiumChargeBombToss.FullTooltip: Xplodium Charge gains a <c val="bfd4fd">2nd</c> charge with a <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> second cooldown between uses and launches <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> more bombs when it detonates.

Tracer.name: Tracer
Tracer.title: Agent of Overwatch
Tracer.SearchText: Tracer Lena Oxton Human Overwatch OW Mobile Mobility Slow Dive Escape Marksman
Tracer.Description: A mobile Assassin who picks off straggling enemies, finishing them off.
Tracer.InfoText: Lena Oxton (call sign: "Tracer"), is both an adventurer and an irrepressible force for good. With the ability to alter her own time at will, she fights the good fight wherever she goes--even the Nexus. Don't worry, loves. The cavalry's finally here.<n/><n/>Tracer is FREE to purchasers of Overwatch™: Origins Edition

TracerBlink.name: Blink
TracerBlink.FullTooltip: Dash towards an area.<n/><n/>Stores up to <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> charges.

TracerMelee.name: Melee
TracerMelee.FullTooltip: Deal <c val="bfd4fd">220~~0.04~~</c> damage to a nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes. Gain <c val="bfd4fd">5%</c> Pulse Bomb charge when using Melee against an enemy, and <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> against Heroes.

TracerRecall.name: Recall
TracerRecall.ShortTooltip: Return to a recent location and remove negative effects
TracerRecall.FullTooltip: After <c val="bfd4fd">1.25</c> seconds, Tracer returns to the position she was at <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds prior to casting, refilling her ammo, and removing all negative status effects from herself.

TracerPulseBomb.name: Pulse Bomb
TracerPulseBomb.ShortTooltip: Attach a bomb to enemies that deals heavy damage
TracerPulseBomb.FullTooltip: Fire a short range bomb that can attach to an enemy if it hits them. The bomb explodes after <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds dealing <c val="bfd4fd">298~~0.06~~</c> damage to them and <c val="bfd4fd">149~~0.06~~</c> damage to other nearby enemies.<n/><n/>This ability is slowly charged over time by dealing damage to enemies with Basic Attacks and Melee.

TracerReload.name: Reload
TracerReload.ShortTooltip: Tracer can move while Basic Attacking; Basic Attacks cost ammo
TracerReload.FullTooltip: Tracer can Basic Attack while moving, and after attacking <c val="bfd4fd">10</c> times she needs to reload over <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds. Tracer can manually reload early by activating Reload.<n/><n/>Basic Attacks heal Tracer for <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> of the damage dealt.

Mount.name: Summon Mount
Mount.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, gain <s val="bfd4fd" name="StandardTooltipDetails">30%</s> Movement Speed.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone
Hearthstone.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring <c val="bfd4fd">1125</c> Health.

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

LootYellVoiceLine.name: Quick Voice Line Expression
LootYellVoiceLine.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by playing your selected Voice Line.

TracerLockedandLoadedFailReload.name: Locked and Loaded
TracerLockedandLoadedFailReload.ShortTooltip: Time Reload perfectly to gain Basic Attack damage
TracerLockedandLoadedFailReload.FullTooltip: Reactivate Reload within the last <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for that magazine.

TracerLockedandLoaded.name: Locked and Loaded
TracerLockedandLoaded.ShortTooltip: Time Reload perfectly to gain Basic Attack damage
TracerLockedandLoaded.FullTooltip: Reactivate Reload within the last <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for that magazine.

TracerOneTwoPunch.name: One-Two Punch
TracerOneTwoPunch.ShortTooltip: Melee gains an additional charge, reduced cooldown
TracerOneTwoPunch.FullTooltip: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second and it gains an additional charge.

TracerPartingGift.name: Parting Gift
TracerPartingGift.FullTooltip: Recall leaves behind <c val="bfd4fd">6</c> bombs that deal <c val="bfd4fd">240~~0.04~~</c> damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">0.75</c> seconds and grant <c val="bfd4fd">7%</c> Pulse Bomb charge.

TracerTracerRounds.name: Tracer Rounds
TracerTracerRounds.FullTooltip: Increase Basic Attack range by <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c>. Basic Attacks against Heroes reveal a small area around them for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

TracerLeechingRounds.name: Leeching Rounds
TracerLeechingRounds.FullTooltip: Increase the healing from Basic Attacks by up to <c val="bfd4fd">200%</c>, based on the amount of health Tracer is missing.

TracerPulseGenerator.name: Pulse Generator

TracerPulseGenerator.FullTooltip: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero heals Tracer for <c val="bfd4fd">12%</c> of her maximum Health over <c val="bfd4fd">1.5</c> seconds and refunds a charge of Blink.

TracerIsThataHealthPack.name: Is That a Health Pack?!
TracerIsThataHealthPack.FullTooltip: Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for <c val="bfd4fd">15%</c> of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> seconds.<n/><n/>Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> of Tracer's maximum Health.

TracerSleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
TracerSleightofHand.FullTooltip: Reduces Reload time by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c>. This equals <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c> more damage per second.

TracerFocusFire.name: Focus Fire
TracerFocusFire.ShortTooltip: Unloading a magazine on an enemy does bonus damage
TracerFocusFire.FullTooltip: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy within <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds, the last bullet will deal <c val="bfd4fd">80~~0.04~~</c> bonus damage. This is equal to <c val="bfd4fd">35%</c> of the total magazine.

TracerLockedandLoaded.name: Locked and Loaded
TracerLockedandLoaded.ShortTooltip: Time Reload perfectly to gain Basic Attack damage
TracerLockedandLoaded.FullTooltip: Reactivate Reload within the last <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> for that magazine.

TracerStickyBomb.name: Sticky Bomb
TracerStickyBomb.ShortTooltip: Increases Pulse Bomb area and adds Slow
TracerStickyBomb.FullTooltip: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> and enemies hit are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd">70%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

TracerQuantumSpike.name: Quantum Spike
TracerQuantumSpike.FullTooltip: Pulse Bomb deals an additional <c val="bfd4fd">6%</c> of maximum Health as damage to Heroes.

TracerPulseRounds.name: Pulse Rounds
TracerPulseRounds.ShortTooltip: Increases Pulse Bomb range and charge rate
TracerPulseRounds.FullTooltip: Increases Pulse Bomb's range and charge rate from Basic Attacks against Heroes by <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c>.

TracerUntouchable.name: Untouchable
TracerUntouchable.FullTooltip: Passive: After Blinking, gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.25 seconds.Quest: Takedowns increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 5%, up to 25%. These bonuses are lost on death.

TracerJumper.name: Jumper
TracerJumper.FullTooltip: <c val="00ff90">Passive</c>: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes <c val="bfd4fd">100%</c> faster.<n/><n/>Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to <c val="bfd4fd">6%</c> of her maximum Health for <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds. This Shield stacks up to <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> times.

TracerTelefrag.name: Telefrag
TracerTelefrag.ShortTooltip: Damage and knockback on Recall arrival
TracerTelefrag.FullTooltip: <c val="00ff90">Passive:</c> Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Recall by <c val="bfd4fd">0.1875</c> seconds.<n/><n/>When Tracer arrives at her Recall location she becomes Unkillable for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second and nearby enemies take <c val="bfd4fd">175~~0.04~~</c> damage and are knocked back.

TracerBulletSprayMelee.name: Bullet Spray
TracerBulletSprayMelee.ShortTooltip: Melee hits all enemies in range
TracerBulletSprayMelee.FullTooltip: Increases the radius of Melee by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c>, and causes it to damage all enemies in range.

TracerHeavyHanded.name: Heavy Handed
TracerHeavyHanded.FullTooltip: Heroes hit by Melee have their Armor reduced by <c val="bfd4fd">15</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.

TracerRicochetHeroWeapon.name: Ricochet

TracerRicochetHeroWeapon.FullTooltip: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a <c val="bfd4fd">60%</c> chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

TracerChronoTriggers.name: Chrono Triggers
TracerChronoTriggers.FullTooltip: Casting Blink causes Basic Attacks to not consume ammo for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second.

TracerGetStuffedMelee.name: Get Stuffed!
TracerGetStuffedMelee.FullTooltip: Increases Melee's Pulse Bomb charge against Heroes from <c val="bfd4fd">10%</c> to <c val="bfd4fd">20%</c>. Hitting an enemy with Melee who is stuck with a Pulse Bomb causes the bomb to instantly explode and knock the target away.

TracerTotalRecallRecall.name: Total Recall
TracerTotalRecallRecall.FullTooltip: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

TracerCompositionBPulseBomb.name: Composition B
TracerCompositionBPulseBomb.ShortTooltip: Hitting Heroes with Pulse Bomb leaves a second
TracerCompositionBPulseBomb.FullTooltip: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero also drops another one at their feet that deals <c val="bfd4fd">50%</c> damage and explodes slightly earlier.

Tychus.name: Tychus
Tychus.title: Notorious Outlaw
Tychus.SearchText: Tychus Findlay Marine Outlaw Terran SC2 SC 2 II StarCraft Wings of Liberty WoL Star2 Starcraft2 Sustain Mobile Mobility Displace Marksman
Tychus.Description: An Assassin who shreds High Health enemies.

TychusOverkillTargeted.name: Overkill

TychusGrenade.name: Frag Grenade

TychusDrakkenLaserDrill.name: Drakken Laser Drill

TychusMinigun.name: Minigun

TychusMinigun.FullTooltip: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to <c val="bfd4fd">2.5%</c> of their maximum Health. Lasts <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds.

Mount.name: Summon Mount
Mount.FullTooltip: After Channeling for <c val="bfd4fd">1</c> second, gain <s val="bfd4fd" name="StandardTooltipDetails">30%</s> Movement Speed.

Hearthstone.name: Hearthstone

LootSpray.name: Quick Spray Expression
LootSpray.FullTooltip: Express yourself to other players by marking the ground with your selected spray.

TychusDrakkenLaserDrillIssueOrder.FullTooltip: Order the Laser Drill to attack a new target.

TychusOdinRagnarokMissilesTargeted.name: Ragnarok Missiles

OverkillTargetedRetarget.name: Overkill Retarget

TychusPressTheAdvantage.name: Press the Advantage

TychusInTheRhythm.FullTooltip: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

TychusTheBiggerTheyAre.name: The Bigger They Are...

TychusCombatTactician.name: Combat Tactician

TychusHeroicAbilityCommandeerOdin.name: Commandeer Odin

TychusHeroicAbilityDrakkenLaserDrill.FullTooltip: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">142~~0.04~~</c> damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over <c val="bfd4fd">25</c> seconds.

TychusMasterySprayNPray.name: Spray 'n' Pray

TychusThatsTheStuff.name: That's the Stuff!

TychusNeosteelCoating.name: Neosteel Coating

TychusMasteryFragGrenadeTitanGrenade.name: Titan Grenade

TychusMasteryDrakkenLaserFocusingDiodes.name: Focusing Diodes

TychusCanDoThisAllDayOverkillTalent.name: Can Do This All Day

TychusRunAndGunBobAndWeave.name: Bob and Weave

Tyrael.name: Tyrael
Tyrael.title: Archangel of Justice
Tyrael.SearchText: Tyrael Angel Justice D2 D3 Diablo2 Diablo3 Diablo 2 3 III Lord of Destruction LoD Reaper of Souls RoS Mobile Mobility Stun Slow Dive Escape
Tyrael.Description: A Tank who pairs well with allies that like to dive into the enemy team.<n/>
Tyrael.InfoText: Among the angels it is the Archangel of Justice Tyrael who is humanity's greatest defender. Wielding his sword El'druin against the Burning Hells, the Prime Evils would have enslaved humanity long ago if Tyrael had not intervened.

TyraelElDruinsMight.name: El'druin's Might
TyraelElDruinsMight.ShortTooltip: Slow and damage enemies in an area. Use ability again to teleport to the area
TyraelElDruinsMight.FullTooltip: Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">110~~0.04~~</c> damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by <c val="bfd4fd">30%</c> for <c val="bfd4fd">2.5</c> seconds. It can be reactivated within <c val="bfd4fd">5</c> seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.

TyraelRighteousness.name: Righteousness
TyraelRighteousness.FullTooltip: Shields Tyrael for <c val="bfd4fd">350~~0.04~~</c> damage and nearby allied Heroes and Minions for <c val="bfd4fd">40%</c> as much for <c val="bfd4fd">4</c> seconds.

TyraelSmite.name: Smite
TyraelSmite.ShortTooltip: Damage an area and speed up nearby allies
TyraelSmite.FullTooltip: Rake target area, dealing <c val="bfd4fd">150~~0.04~~</c> damage. For the next <c val="bfd4fd">3</c> seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain <c val="bfd4fd">25%</c> increased Movement Speed for <c val="bfd4fd">2</c> seconds.

TyraelJudgement.name: Judgment
